member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.Native.Power.Shutdown(System.Int32,System.DateTime)
member.summary: Powers off until either one of the selected wake-up pins asserts or the RTC alarm fires.
member.param:
OR-combined wake-up pin bit mask. Each SoC's pin-package exposes a WakeupPin class (e.g. SC20260.WakeupPin.PA0) with one int constant per pin its hardware can wake on; OR them together to allow any of those pins to wake the device. Pass 0 for RTC-only wake. A bit not routed to this SoC's wake-up peripheral throws .
Example: Power.Shutdown(SC20260.WakeupPin.PA0 | SC20260.WakeupPin.PA2, t).
Wall-clock time at which the RTC should wake the device, or for "pin only".
member.exception: Thrown when is 0 AND is (no wake source — the device would never come back), or when any bit in isn't routed to this SoC's hardware wake-up peripheral.
